read_binary_primitives: use Decoder to read big-endian binary primitives like bytes, shorts, ints, longs, floats, and doubles from a file
read_string: use Decoder.readString to read a length-prefixed null-terminated UTF-8 string from binary data
read_position: use Decoder.readIntPos or readFloatPos to read 3D position tuples from a binary stream
read_look_direction: use Decoder.readLook to read a pair of float yaw and pitch values from binary data
read_block_item: use Decoder.readBlock or readItem to read Minecraft block and item tuples from binary log data
